admission.boundary_power_iterations: 0 for quant-only rebase, otherwise explicit integer in [1,32]

initialization_modes.quant_only: fast symmetric-INT8 boundary with zero initial compensators

decode_backends.vector: direct AscendC vector readout and recurrence path
decode_backends.cube: paired key/query INT8 Cube projections with BF16 preparation and finish kernels

boundary_workspace: quant-only rebase scales the 16 record keys in an AscendC vector kernel, merges correction-transpose times scaled keys with one FP16-input/FP32-output Cube GEMM per state, then requantizes from the FP32 128x128 workspace
decode_projection: single AscendC vector kernel consumes and emits Qwen3.5 BF16 tensors directly, applies FP32 log-decay internally, splits each TP-local 16-head state over two column shards, reads residuals in eight-column tiles, batches sixteen boundary products into one reduction, bulk-loads metadata and record tensors into UB, compile-specializes the quant-only zero-compensator path, and preserves the p=16 exact-update window
lifecycle: boundary output buffers, FP32 Cube workspace, scaled-record workspace, and Cube tiling handle are allocated when the encoded slot is created and reused across p=16 refits

supports: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B TP2 eager AgentX first-turn 649-prompt/128-output matched comparison
does_not_support: performance outside the recorded AgentX first-turn workload
